what_it_does: Modern AI chips are built by stacking multiple smaller chips (called chiplets) on a single package, like a 3D sandwich. This paper describes a standardized link that lets one chip talk to another chip at ultra-high speed with very low power consumption. The innovation is that this follows a new industry standard (UCIe) so chips from different manufacturers can work together. The link achieves 5.27 trillion bits per second per square millimeter of chip area, using only 0.29 picojoules of energy per bit. This is built in cutting-edge 3nm technology and packaged using a special 2.5D stacking technique.
